name: K-C Loudon Mill - Loudon TN
type: Tissue manufacturing mill (K-C Professional / consumer tissue)

fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or staffed checkpoint found at the property entrance in satellite or 2024 Street View. The entry road passes a landscaped monument-sign roundabout but is otherwise an open industrial driveway. Set false; flagged uncertain - a gate further inside the yard cannot be ruled out due to limited Street View coverage of the internal road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any entrance. Set false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - no controlled gate identified, so no remote-checkin inference.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Manufacturing mill has dock faces on its SW side; the separate distribution warehouse to the NE has its own dock bank serving the drop yard - physically separate dock clusters on different buildings.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main tissue mill, a separate large distribution warehouse, plus a wastewater treatment area to the NW.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large drop yards around the warehouse - multiple long rows of angled-parked trailers, 100+ visible; banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~30 doors estimated across the mill SW face and the warehouse face - honest estimate, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property in current imagery.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible from overhead; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the mill sits on Watts Bar Lake at the wooded edge of the small town of Loudon, TN.
